name: Extreme heat
summary: BoM warns of severe to extreme heatwave in Queensland's Peninsula through 14–15 Nov; no deadly top-tier event found
state: The Bureau of Meteorology's Queensland heatwave warning issued on 12 Nov forecast severe to extreme heatwave conditions in the Peninsula through the weekend of 14–15 Nov, easing in the Gulf Country, with maximums in the high 30s to low 40s°C (WillyWeather, citing BoM). Mozambique's weather service INAM extended a heatwave warning for Manica and Tete provinces to 8 Nov, with highs up to 43°C (Club of Mozambique). Regional warnings meet the Watch line; no deadly heatwave under top-tier warnings across a large population was found as of 13 Nov.
for_you: People in Cape York and nearby remote communities face high heat through 15 Nov; older people, young children and outdoor workers are most at risk. Queensland Health and the Bureau of Meteorology publish heat warnings and advice.
rubric_hit: Watch: heatwave warnings across a major region — BoM severe to extreme heatwave warning, Queensland Peninsula (12 Nov)

why: Heat is the deadliest weather hazard globally, straining power grids, crops and health systems.
drivers: Heat domes, climate warming, season, humidity, urban heat islands.

rubric.alert: Deadly heatwave with top-tier official warnings across a large population.
